name: server-noonien
description: Shared, serverless, conflict-free memory for AI agents — a multi-machine drop-in for the MCP memory knowledge graph.
long_description: A drop-in replacement for the official `@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory` knowledge graph (the same nine tools) that **converges across machines** with no central server, no database and no merge conflicts. Each node keeps its own append-only shard; a companion daemon (`nooniend`) replicates the shards peer-to-peer, so several machines share one memory with no shared folder — only IP reachability over a VPN or a LAN.

directory.title: Shard directory
directory.description: Directory holding this machine's shards. Leave empty for the default (~/.noonien).

node_id.title: Node id
node_id.description: This node's shard name. Must be unique per machine. Leave empty to use the hostname.
